title: Make Repo Logging Configurable
description: Introduce .repo/config.toml to control hook logging (session files, operations, plan, detail). Default session file logging off.
summary: Added .repo/config.toml with [logging] (session off by default, operations, plan, detail). Repo CLI loads config in writeHookArtifacts and gates session.json writes, derived repo-operation events, plan tracking, and native/response detail. Extended repo/client/cli tests; focused hook/config tests pass.
